rule_title: TTP 1569.002 - Metasploit Service Execution Payload Deployed
description: Detects Metasploit deploying a payload via a transient service using the hardcoded psexec/service execution module template. The ServiceFileName always begins with %COMSPEC% /b /c start /b /min powershell.exe -nop -w hidden -noni, runs as LocalSystem with demand-start, and uses a random short service name. The PowerShell body contains a GZip-compressed Base64 stager payload.
